features.name: Android WYSIWYG Markdown Editor
features.description: Replace the read-only MarkdownPreview toggle in EditorScreen.kt with an editable WYSIWYG editor (richeditor-compose RichTextEditor) in eye mode, keeping BasicTextField+SyntaxHighlightTransformation as the raw/pencil mode. contentField.text stays the single source of truth (markdown), synced bidirectionally via setMarkdown()/toMarkdown().
features.evidence: FINAL ARCHITECTURE (after user found the AST round-trip approach unfixably reformats untouched content): reverted richeditor-compose entirely. EditorScreen.kt content is now a SINGLE always-present BasicTextField bound to contentField.text in both eye and pencil modes; only the VisualTransformation differs (identity offset mapping in both cases, so contentField.text is never touched by mode switching or anything the user didn't type). New MarkdownVisualTransformation.kt / MarkdownLiveStyle (apps/android/ui/components) does live markdown styling — dimmed markers, scaled/colored headers, styled bold/italic/strikethrough/code/lists/blockquotes/links/hr — purely as display decoration over the raw string, same technique as the existing SyntaxHighlightTransformation. Added MarkdownVisualTransformationTest.kt (12 tests) pinning byte-for-byte text preservation, including the exact blockquote example that surfaced the original bug. Deleted dead MarkdownPreview.kt. Verified: ./gradlew :apps:android:compileDebugKotlin, :apps:android:testDebugUnitTest (12/12 new tests green), and full ./init.sh all green, no regressions.
